``` {r lmer worried}

# age, sex?

m_n <- lmer(worried ~ sch_neg + (1|id_esm), data = dat_1)
m_p <- lmer(worried ~ sch_pos + (1|id_esm), data = dat_1)
m_d <- lmer(worried ~ sch_dis + (1|id_esm), data = dat_1)


m_np <- lmer(worried ~ sch_neg + sch_pos + (1|id_esm), data = dat_1)
m_pd <- lmer(worried ~ sch_pos + sch_dis + (1|id_esm), data = dat_1) # curious
m_nd <- lmer(worried ~ sch_neg + sch_dis + (1|id_esm), data = dat_1) # curious

m_all <- lmer(worried ~ sch_neg + sch_pos + sch_dis + (1|id_esm), data = dat_1)
  
cat("\n--- SCH_NEG ---\n")
summary(m_n)
cat("\n--- SCH_POS ---\n")
summary(m_p)
cat("\n--- SCH_DIS ---\n")
summary(m_d)
cat("\n--- SCH_NEG + SCH_POS ---\n")
summary(m_np)
cat("\n--- SCH_POS + SCH_DIS ---\n")
summary(m_pd)
cat("\n--- SCH_NEG + SCH_DIS ---\n")
summary(m_nd)
cat("\n--- SCH_POS + SCH_NEG + SCH_DIS ---\n")
summary(m_all)

tab_model(m_n, m_np, m_all, show.aicc = T, show.std = T, file = "lmer_models.doc")

```

``` {r extacting lmer data for visualization function}

build_plot_data <- function(model, raw_data, focal_var, model_name = "Model", steps = 100) {
  
  # 1. Filter out missing data (NA)
  variables <- all.vars(formula(model))
  lmer_data <- na.omit(raw_data[, variables, drop = FALSE])
  
  # 2. Extract the approximated p-value using standard lme4 output
  coef_table <- coef(summary(model))
  
  if (focal_var %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
    t_value <- coef_table[focal_var, "t value"]
    extracted_p_value <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(t_value)))
  } else {
    extracted_p_value <- NA 
  }
  
  # 3. Determine the minimum and maximum of the X-axis (the focal variable)
  var_min <- 0
  var_max <- 12
  x_vals <- seq(var_min, var_max, length.out = steps) 
  
  # 4. Extract the Variance-Covariance matrix of the model for CI calculation
  V_matrix <- as.matrix(vcov(model))
  
  results <- list()
  
  # 5. THE THOUGHT EXPERIMENT: Iterate through the points on the X-axis
  for (x in x_vals) {
    
    # A) Take the real data 
    temp_data <- lmer_data
    
    # B) ONLY overwrite the focal variable for everyone to the current scale point
    temp_data[[focal_var]] <- x 
    
    # C) Prediction in the real context
    pred_vals <- predict(model, newdata = temp_data, re.form = NA)
    
    # D) Calculate Confidence Interval 
    X_matrix <- model.matrix(terms(model), temp_data)
    se_vals <- sqrt(rowSums((X_matrix %*% V_matrix) * X_matrix))
    
    # E) Averaging 
    mean_pred <- mean(pred_vals)
    mean_se <- mean(se_vals)
    
    # F) Save the results to the final table
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      dim_value = x,
      worried_value = mean_pred,
      conf.low = mean_pred - (1.96 * mean_se),
      conf.high = mean_pred + (1.96 * mean_se),
      p_value = extracted_p_value,
      dimension = focal_var,
      model = model_name,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # Return the combined table
  return(do.call(rbind, results))
}

```

``` {r extacting lmer data for visualization}

df_mn <- build_plot_data(model = m_n, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_neg", 
                         model_name = "Negatív")
df_mp <- build_plot_data(model = m_p, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_pos", 
                         model_name = "Pozitív")
df_md <- build_plot_data(model = m_d, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_dis", 
                         model_name = "Dezorganizált")

df_m_np_n <- build_plot_data(model = m_np, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_neg", 
                             model_name = "Negatív - Pozitív")
df_m_np_p <- build_plot_data(model = m_np, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_pos", 
                             model_name = "Negatív - Pozitív")

df_m_pd_p <- build_plot_data(model = m_pd, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_pos", 
                             model_name = "Pozitív - Dezorganizált")
df_m_pd_d <- build_plot_data(model = m_pd, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_dis", 
                             model_name = "Pozitív - Dezorganizált")

df_m_nd_n <- build_plot_data(model = m_nd, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_neg", 
                             model_name = "Dezorganizált - Negatív")
df_m_nd_d <- build_plot_data(model = m_nd, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_dis", 
                             model_name = "Dezorganizált - Negatív")

df_m_all_n <- build_plot_data(model = m_all, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_neg", 
                              model_name = "Negatív - Pozitív - Dezorganizált")
df_m_all_p <- build_plot_data(model = m_all, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_pos", 
                              model_name = "Negatív - Pozitív - Dezorganizált")
df_m_all_d <- build_plot_data(model = m_all, raw_data = dat_1, focal_var = "sch_dis", 
                              model_name = "Negatív - Pozitív - Dezorganizált")

### Bind rows datasets

dat_lmer_all <- bind_rows(df_m_all_n, df_m_all_p, df_m_all_d) %>%
  mutate(dimension = factor(dimension, 
                           levels = c("sch_neg", "sch_pos", "sch_dis"),
                           labels = c("Negatív", "Pozitív", "Dezorganizált")))

dat_lmer_facet <- bind_rows(df_mn, df_mp, df_md,
                            df_m_np_n, df_m_np_p,
                            df_m_pd_p, df_m_pd_d,
                            df_m_nd_n, df_m_nd_d) %>%
  mutate(dimension = factor(dimension, 
                           levels = c("sch_neg", "sch_pos", "sch_dis"),
                           labels = c("Negatív", "Pozitív", "Dezorganizált"))) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model,
                        levels = c("Negatív", "Dezorganizált - Negatív",
                                   "Pozitív", "Negatív - Pozitív",
                                   "Dezorganizált", "Pozitív - Dezorganizált")))

```

``` {r lmer plot all}

colors <- c("Negatív" = "#80B1D3", 
            "Pozitív" = "#FC8D62FF", 
            "Dezorganizált" = "#BC80BD") 


plot_lmer_all <- ggplot(dat_lmer_all, aes(dim_value, worried_value , color = dimension, fill = dimension)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Dimenzió",
                    labels = c("Negatív", "Pozitív", "Dezorganizált"),
                    values = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Dimenzió",
                     labels = c("Negatív", "Pozitív", "Dezorganizált"),
                     values = colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(1, 4)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 8), breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8)) +
  # labs(title = "A dimenziók hatása az aggodalom átlagszintjére multilevel modell eredményei alapján",
       # x = "MSS-B dimenziók pontszáma", 
       # y = "Aggodalom átlaga") + 
  labs(title = NULL,
       x = NULL, 
       y = NULL) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0.2, 0.2, 1, 0.2), "cm")) +
  facet_wrap(~ model)

print(plot_lmer_all)

```

``` {r lmer plots facet}

plot_lmer_facet <- ggplot(dat_lmer_facet, aes(dim_value, worried_value , color = dimension, fill = dimension)) +
```
